introHtml: Brown lanyards and badges offer a natural, earthy look that stands out from standard black or navy options. Ideal for outdoor events, trade shows, or organizations with a rustic brand identity, these accessories pair well with earth-tone uniforms or logo colors. Choose from nylon or polyester webbing with metal or plastic hardware, and add your logo through screen printing or dye sublimation for a professional finish that lasts.
